messages:
Lina (AE): NorthSky ready to convert POC to paid but procurement insists on signing SCCs + DPA with HSM attest. They require a CSV order line for SAP ingestion. Who can confirm quick path?
Evan (Legal): SCCs + DPA redlines look standard but they added a wet-ink clause for MSA execution which is annoying. We can accept SCCs with minor edits. For MSA signature, propose DocuSign with audit trail; wet-ink only if regulatory mandate shown.
NorthSky Procurement: Our AP cannot import JSON. Need single-line CSV: customer,po,sku,region,qty,monthly_price,billing_contact,invoice_email,sla,kms_mode. Region must be eu-west-1. SLA 99.95 required.
Vera (SE): HSM: Hosted = Thales managed; Dedicated = BYOK. Attestation letter available on letterhead in 3-5 bd. If they demand FIPS module docs, add 7-12 bd. Suggest include attestation_pending=true field.
Omar (Finance): Net30 is ok if PO arrives. Provide remit-to and VAT in the CSV line. Invoices go to invoices@northsky.com and cc finance@redwood.com. billing-bot: will attach billing template after PO number is supplied.
Lina (AE): Pasting single-line CSV for their AP to ingest (copy/paste):
```csv
customer,po,sku,region,qty,monthly_price,billing_contact,invoice_email,sla,kms_mode,vat,remit_to,attestation_pending
NorthSky Ltd,<PO_NUMBER>,RD-DED-XL,eu-west-1,5,150000,payables@northsky.com,invoices@northsky.com,99.95,BYOK|vendor-hsm,GB999999999,Redwood Ltd, true
```
Evan (Legal): I'll upload an MSA patch that clarifies electronic signatures are acceptable with audit trail and adds DPA exhibit. contracts-bot: MSA_NorthSky_patch.pdf uploaded by @Evan.
contracts-bot: Document uploaded: MSA_NorthSky_patch.pdf reviewer=Evan (Legal).
NorthSky Procurement: Can you confirm if keys will be customer-controlled for Dedicated? Also need HSM vendor name on company letterhead for compliance team.
Vera (SE): Confirmed: Dedicated = BYOK (customer retains keys). Hosted = Thales; we can provide signed attestation letter (Thales on letterhead) in ~3-5 bd. If they require combined SOC2+HSM paperwork, expect 7-10 bd.
Omar (Finance): Once we get PO + CSV line, route invoice to invoices@northsky.com and cc finance@redwood.com. I'll create billing account with Net30.
Lina (AE): Plan: 1) Evan posts final MSA/DPA with signature language; 2) I send CSV and DocuSign envelope; 3) Omar finalizes billing after PO. If procurement insists on wet-ink, we need an approval from @sales-lead to proceed. :thumbsup:
